description: Borowy, the lord of the deep spruce forest, a very tall and gaunt forest spirit with dark grey-brown bark for skin, a crown of big branching antlers on his head, a long beard of grey moss, glowing green eyes, very long thin arms with long twig-like fingers, a ragged cloak of dark spruce branches on his shoulders, menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, no trees, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture, the whole antlers
